name: cross-asset-validation
description: Cross-asset validation: evaluate V2 pipeline (nguoc_trend + max_pen≤0.20 + R:R 3.0) on XAUUSD full (2018→2026, 204k bars) and EURUSD (2018→2026, 215k bars). Compare event volume, filter stack effectiveness (nguoc_trend → triple intersection), PF, PR-AUC, breakeven cost, sample size. Determine if V2 generalizes across assets. Deliver final cross-asset comparison report.

members.name: ML_Engineer
members.executionPrompt: You are a quantitative analyst for liquidity-sweep strategy evaluation. Your job is to: (1) write and run deterministic Python scripts that apply the V2 pipeline (sweep_detector_v2: nguoc_trend + max_pen≤0.20 + configurable R:R) to XAUUSD full (2018→2026) and EURUSD (2018→2026) data; (2) compute event counts, PF, breakeven cost, filter stack progression for each asset; (3) ensure all scripts are deterministic (fixed seed), outputs saved as JSON+MD. Use the existing pipeline_v2/src/events/sweep_detector_v2.py and src/ modules. Never modify baseline v1.2.0 code. All outputs go to pipeline_v2/reports/analysis/cross_asset/.

members.name: QA_Auditor
members.executionPrompt: You are a QA auditor for quantitative strategy analysis. Your job is to: (1) verify that scripts run with exit code 0 and produce deterministic outputs; (2) check that baseline v1.2.0 is not modified; (3) review analysis logic for correctness (sample size, CI, PF calculation, no look-ahead bias); (4) report findings with severity (blocker/high/medium/low). You do NOT modify any code. You report PASS/FAIL verdict with evidence.

members.name: Lead_Integrator
members.executionPrompt: You are the synthesis and recommendations integrator. Your job is to: (1) collect all analysis outputs from ML_Engineer; (2) create a comprehensive cross-asset comparison report (MD + JSON) comparing V2 performance on XAUUSD original (6/2022→2026), XAUUSD full (2018→2026), and EURUSD (2018→2026); (3) answer: does V2 generalize? What differences exist between assets? What is the recommendation for moving forward? All outputs go to pipeline_v2/reports/analysis/cross_asset/.

tasks.subject: V2 analysis: XAUUSD full + EURUSD
tasks.objective: Write and run a deterministic Python script that applies the V2 pipeline detector (sweep_detector_v2: nguoc_trend + max_pen≤0.20 + R:R 3.0) to BOTH XAUUSD full (2018→2026, 204k bars) and EURUSD (2018→2026, 215k bars). For each asset compute: event volume, filter stack effectiveness (nguoc_trend only → nguoc+prob≥0.25 → triple intersection), PF pre/post cost 0.05R, breakeven cost, sample sizes, CI. All outputs to pipeline_v2/reports/analysis/cross_asset/.
acceptance: Script runs with exit code 0 for both datasets
Outputs saved as JSON + MD per asset
Event counts, PF, CI reported for each filter level

findings.problem: Cross_asset_comparison.json contains a generated timestamp (pd.Timestamp.now().isoformat()) that varies per run, causing non-deterministic MD5 across re-runs.
findings.requiredFix: Remove or freeze the generated timestamp to make the JSON output fully deterministic. Per-asset JSONs (xauusd_full_analysis.json, eurusd_analysis.json) already are deterministic.

findings.problem: 6/13 v1.2.0 frozen report files (walk_forward_report, top_prob_subset_analysis, score_bucket_report) had their MD5 changed by the original v2 pipeline run (documented in freeze_status_v2.0.0.md). The cross-asset analysis script itself does NOT touch baseline files.
findings.requiredFix: Isolate v2 output paths from v1.2.0 baseline paths. The v2 pipeline runner already has partial .baseline_backup restore; ensure ALL report files are restored after v2 runs.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Script re-run produces identical outputs for both assets
acceptanceResults.evidence: Re-ran cross_asset_analysis.py twice. Per-asset JSONs (xauusd_full_analysis.json, eurusd_analysis.json) are byte-identical (MD5 match). Comparison JSON differs only by cosmetic 'generated' timestamp — an accepted non-analytical variance.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Event counts and PF calculations verified
acceptanceResults.evidence: XAUUSD: net_valid=240, PF@3R post-cost=1.7031, breakeven=0.3841R. EURUSD: net_valid=267, PF@3R post-cost=1.2473, breakeven=0.1841R. Outcome sums match net_valid (240=55+98+87+0; 267=46+125+96+0). Direction splits sum match. Python cross-check passed all assertions.

5/5 core frozen artifacts verified: model.pkl (69d65883), calibrator.pkl (ca1d7e61), test_metrics.json (3087b9e36), labeled_events.parquet (fac22cea82ef), liquidity_sweep_events.parquet (fac22cea82ef). All MD5s match v1.2.0 spec. Cross-asset analysis script only writes to pipeline_v2/reports/analysis/cross_asset/, never touches baseline paths.

Entry mode: next_open_after_confirmation (enters on bar after confirmation, never same bar). H1 trend: uses build_htf_context with ffill+shift(1) — strictly closed-H1-candle only, no future information. V2 detection uses standard ATR (period=14) computed on historical bars. Labeling uses primary_horizon=16 (forward-looking after entry, which is correct for trade outcome labeling).

PF 95% CI: bootstrap with n=3000 resamples at seed=42 (per-asset uses SEED+200/201 for RR pre/post, ensuring deterministic resampling). Wilson CI applied to net positive rate. Bootstrap CI range encloses the point estimate correctly (XAUUSD 95%CI=[1.2508,2.2604] encloses PF=1.7031; EURUSD 95%CI=[0.9335,1.6238] encloses PF=1.2473). Wilson CI bounds are in [0,1] range.
